title: One-bit recurrence for word probability
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $P$ be a predicate on Boolean words. The probability that a uniformly random Boolean word of length $n+1$ satisfies $P$ is the average of the probabilities that a uniformly random length-$n$ word, prefixed by true or by false, satisfies $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on Boolean words
